posts.body:
WADEEM GARDENS — RELEASE-TIMELINE UPDATE
Modon | Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi

New broker intelligence adds a provisional release sequence: AED 50,000 EOI closes 28 September, VIP sales are indicated for 29 September and public sales for 1 October. Modon has not independently confirmed these dates in accessible public material.

Broker-indicated prices: 4BR from AED 8.7m, 5BR from AED 10.2m and 6BR from AED 11.6m. Advertised 25/75 payment and Q2 2031 handover remain unconfirmed developer-side terms.

Why it matters: buyers now have a near-term decision window for the 4–6BR villa release on Hudayriyat Island.
Confidence: medium-high on project and product; medium on timing and commercial terms.
